In the upcoming WTA singles match scheduled for 2026-10-30 05:30 UTC: if Elena Rybakina wins the match, this market resolves to "Elena Rybakina"; if Leylah Fernandez wins, it resolves to "Leylah Fernandez". The winner is the first player to claim the required number of sets under the match's official best-of format.

If the match begins but is not completed, a retirement or default counts the opposing player as the winner. If a walkover is declared before the first point is played, the match is outright canceled, or it is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50.

Suspensions caused by weather, fading light, or other tournament-imposed delays do not close this market — it stays open until the match is officially completed, provided it concludes within the 7-day window mentioned above.

Resolution Source: The official WTA Tour scoring page.

Note: This market will resolve strictly based on the first officially published result from the designated source. Any subsequent revisions will not affect this resolution.
